title: Fact or hype: local voice cloning, no cloud
caption: Open code, open weights, public-domain voice. Runs on a Mac: 21 s of speech in 32 s, $0, no API key.
credits: Voice: Steve Jackson, LibriVox (CC0), via voice-zero
Model: VoxCPM2 (OpenBMB), MLX port by mlx-community

scenes.narration: Local voice cloning. No cloud. No A P I key. Fact or hype?
The code is M I T. The weights are Apache two point oh.
Here is the real run. Eight seconds of a public domain voice goes in. Twenty one seconds of speech comes out, in thirty two seconds, on a MacBook.
Verdict. It runs locally, on open code and open weights, for zero dollars. How does it compare to ElevenLabs? I have not benchmarked it. You tell me.
Code and weights are on GitHub. Voice: Steve Jackson, from LibriVox.
